reason: The model controls for mgmt_rating_2023, which is measured in 2023 after the 2021-22 training. It is a likely mediator or collider, so conditioning on it can bias the training coefficient and even flip its sign. The strongly negative estimate (-2.14) is therefore not credible. The analysis also trims the sample on the outcome and reports only one specification with no robustness check without that control. I could not re-run the code to check this.
